question: What decision currently governs the Python metadata specification chain? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-314 (Metadata for Python Software Packages 1.1) is the currently active decision governing the Python metadata specification chain, having superseded PEP-241.
The authority evidence for PEP-314 is documented at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/a0d411a7e334ddede263fdf9862f06bfc035f21c/pep-0314.txt.
PEP-241 originally specified Metadata for Python Software Packages before being replaced by PEP-314.
